verses: I, Thomas the Israelite, make known to you the great deeds of the childhood of our Lord Jesus Christ.
When the boy Jesus was five years old, he made twelve sparrows from clay on the Sabbath. When Joseph scolded him, Jesus clapped his hands and the sparrows flew away.
The son of Annas the scribe scattered the water Jesus had gathered. Jesus said: 'You will dry up like a tree.' The boy withered completely.
A boy ran against Jesus' shoulder. Jesus said: 'You will not continue your journey.' The boy fell down and died.
A teacher named Zacchaeus tried to teach Jesus letters. Jesus said: 'If you know the Alpha, teach us the Beta.' The teacher struck Jesus and died.
Joseph was afraid and said to Mary: 'Do not let him go outside.'
Another teacher tried to teach Jesus. Jesus said: 'I know the letters better than you.' The teacher was amazed.
Jesus said: 'I am from above. I have been sent for you, and I will teach you things no one else knows.' All who heard were amazed.
Joseph took Jesus to a dyer. Jesus threw all the fabrics into a single vat of blue, then produced each in its proper color. The dyer praised God.
Jesus found a dead fish and said: 'I command you, live.' The fish came to life and swam away.
Jesus found a man working on the Sabbath and said: 'If you know what you do, you are blessed; if not, you are cursed.'
A boy broke Jesus' pitcher. Jesus spread his cloak, filled it with water, and carried it to his mother.
Jesus sowed wheat with Joseph. The harvest yielded a hundred large measures. Joseph blessed him.
Jesus spread his cloak and drew water when his pitcher was broken.
Jesus made a short beam longer by stretching it. Joseph marveled at the miracle.
Jesus took his mother's veil and caught seed a man was sowing. He returned it, saying: 'You will receive a hundredfold.'
At age twelve, Jesus remained in the temple among the teachers. All were amazed at his understanding.
Mary found him after three days. Jesus said: 'Do you not know that I must be in my Father's house?'
Jesus increased in wisdom and stature and in favor with God and humanity.
After these things, Jesus performed many other miracles. I, Thomas, have written this account so that all may know his wonderful works.
All these things are recorded in the archives of the temple. May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all who read. Amen.
